dogecoin.text: @MalwareTechBlog I am not an advocate for dogecoin, just pointing out it's only a hope skip and jump away from being litecoin or bitcoin. Both of which have also lost their core usefulness.

@MalwareTechBlog Dogecoin is same as litecoin which is a modified version of bitcoin.  Came from same codebase. So pretty much just as secure as long as you have enough nodes. Which i think dogecoin has over 1000. So even though it's meme central it's just as valid.
